label: What a borrower is charged for a run, from what it really cost and the lender's mark-up

params.name: base_usd
params.label: What the provider really charged the key's owner

params.name: markup_pct
params.label: Per cent the owner adds on top (0 = at cost)

params.name: decimals
params.label: Places the charged amount is kept to

description_nl: base_usd is what the provider actually billed the key's owner. markup_pct is what that owner adds on top when lending the key - 0 means at cost. The answer is what the borrower is shown and what their bill says. The owner's own balance still moves by base_usd, never by this.
weight_basis: The mark-up formula, in ONE place. A borrower never sees base_usd; the owner sees both.
